weight_estimation_method: Estimated steel U-bolt mass: theoretical solid steel rod at 7,850 kg/m³ using centreline length = 2 × nominal leg length + π × (inside width + rod diameter) / 2, plus two estimated hex nuts (M20 60.5 g each; M22 85 g each). Nominal inch leg length is converted using the existing Nirmal catalogue model convention of 25 mm per inch. Packed checkout weight adds 5% and rounds up to the next 50 g.
weight_estimation_notes: Calculated estimate only; not manufacturer-weighed. U-bolt profile, end threads, bends, plating, exact nut grade/geometry and actual leg length can change mass. applications: Vehicle fitment evidence (Texspin Master Price List 2025–26, pp. 63–64; exact part-number match): Tata 1312 standard kingpin shaft, chrome-plated.
dimensions_label: Per pin: diameter × overall length (mm)
weight_estimation_method: Theoretical solid-cylinder steel estimate at 7,850 kg/m³, multiplied by 2 pins per sellable set; packed estimate adds 5% and rounds up to the next 50 g. Dimensions are cross-referenced to the matching Tata axle/oversize specification published by Rajindra Mechanical Works, not verified against a Texspin engineering drawing.
weight_estimation_notes: This catalogue item is a set of two kingpin shafts. The 204 mm / 205 mm overall length is a cross-reference to Rajindra Mechanical Works' equivalent Tata 1109/1210 or Tata 1312 kingpin listing at the corresponding oversize diameter. It is not a Texspin-confirmed dimension. Weight is a theoretical solid-cylinder estimate for both pins combined; actual stepped profiles, grooves, flats, bores, threads, material and finish can reduce or change mass. Packed weight includes a 5% allowance rounded to 50 g and is not a carrier-confirmed shipment weight.

name: 2HAVX13-1325 Banded Fan Belt
description: The PIX 2HAVX13-1325 is an EPDM raw-edge cogged banded V-belt designed for multi-groove automotive drive systems. name: Rear Spring Pin 35x149
description: The JAI P35149 Rear Spring Pin 35x149 locates a suspension or steering joint and provides a pivot surface for the connected link, lever or spring-eye assembly. Vehicle applications include Tata 2416 and Tata LPT.
dimensions_label: Diameter × overall length (mm)
weight_estimation_method: Solid-cylinder steel estimate at 7,850 kg/m³; approx_weight_g adds 5% packaging allowance and rounds up to the next 50 g.
weight_estimation_notes: Estimated from nominal diameter and overall length in the product name; actual stepped features, holes, grooves and chamfers are not measured.
applications: Fitment status — supplier/OE confirmation pending for JAI code P35149: the part title identifies Rear Spring Pin 35x149, but the supplier references available in this audit do not provide a vehicle-specific cross-reference for Tata 2416, Tata LPT. The dimensional code alone does not prove make/model compatibility. Confirm actual pin/lever diameter and length, bush or spring-eye width, end profile, lubrication groove and axle/steering position against the vehicle and JAI pack marking before treating the listed vehicle mapping as verified.
hsn_description: Springpins, of iron or steel
hsn_basis: The product is expressly a spring pin.
hsn_review_note: Confirm iron/steel construction.

name: Bolt w/ Nut 20 x 102 x 10" HR
description: The Nirmal NIRMAL/UB/372AB Bolt w/ Nut 20 x 102 x 10" HR clamps a vehicle axle or associated component to the leaf-spring pack or mounting structure. Vehicle applications include Ashok Leyland U Truck.
applications: Vehicle fitment evidence (Nirmal Price List No. 67/2026, p. 8; exact part-number match): Leyland U-Truck 2528 and 4923, truck/trailer front or rear U-bolt application.
hsn_description: Other screws and bolts, whether or not with their nuts or washers, of iron or steel
hsn_basis: The product is identified as a vehicle bolt/fastener.
hsn_review_note: Confirm iron/steel construction and that the kit is principally bolts/fasteners.
weight_estimation_method: Estimated steel U-bolt mass: theoretical solid steel rod at 7,850 kg/m³ using centreline length = 2 × nominal leg length + π × (inside width + rod diameter) / 2, plus two estimated hex nuts (M20 60.5 g each; M22 85 g each). Nominal inch leg length is converted using the existing Nirmal catalogue model convention of 25 mm per inch. Packed checkout weight adds 5% and rounds up to the next 50 g.
weight_estimation_notes: Calculated estimate only; not manufacturer-weighed. U-bolt profile, end threads, bends, plating, exact nut grade/geometry and actual leg length can change mass. Confirm with a physical sample before treating as a net weight. Product dimensions are component geometry, not packed-carton dimensions.
